_doc: object -> (extract, analyze, constraint, retention). TYPE_RULE covers any table via DD02L class; OVERRIDE = special/non-table elements.

TRANSP: P01-secured: NO ROWSKIPS (read ROWSKIPS-free, date-chunked); split wide fields
POOL: pool table: RFC returns the key field only; values via a content FM (e.g. RS_VARIANT_CONTENTS)
CLUSTER: cluster behind e.g. CDCLS/RFBLG: RFC_READ_TABLE cannot read it; sometimes declustered on EhP8 — probe first
VIEW: DB/projection view — read like a transparent table

RSAU: chunk <=6h (2-day call hangs); conn poisons ~every 12 calls -> reconnect; transient 'partner not reached' -> resilient reconnect
SM21: SALC_MSC_READ_SYSLOG returns 0; Z_READ_SYSLOG broken; RFC_READ_TABLE n/a
ST22: SNAP TABLE_NOT_AVAILABLE; RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN no auth on P01
SNAP: the SNAP table is not RFC-readable; use the dump FM
STAD: workload stats, not a table; kernel-verify; date/time/host params
CDPOS: cluster; pair with CDHDR by OBJECTCLAS+OBJECTID+CHANGENR; declustered sometimes on EhP8 -> probe
RFC_STREAM: RSAU 'RFC Function Call' events; parse PARAMX host/dest/user
the call stream lives in the audit log, not a table; ORIGIN axis = host/dest/user
SOAMANAGER_GUID: the dest GUIDs are external connection IDs, not SAP-named ports (not in RFCDES; SRT_* are SOAP, calls are RFC)
